pkgmetadata.longdescription: Jazz² Resurrection is a reimplementation of Jazz Jackrabbit 2. It supports the Shareware Demo, Holiday Hare '98, The Secret Files and Christmas Chronicles, and parts of the JJ2+ extension and MLLE. The original game's data files are required and are not included.

use.flag: Enable scripting with dev-libs/angelscript, used by JJ2+ levels
Play tracker module music with media-libs/libopenmpt
